We’re looking for a visual storyteller who can turn a client objective or rough idea into a compelling, production-ready creative plan.



The Role



As our **Creative Producer — Scripts & Storyboards, you will shape what we film and how each story unfolds on screen.



You’ll develop concepts, write scripts, create treatments and storyboards, and build detailed shot lists for short-form branded content. You’ll work closely with our production team to ensure every concept is creatively strong, visually clear, and realistic to produce.



This is not a social media copywriting or production-coordination role. It is a hands-on creative-development position for someone who thinks like both a writer and a filmmaker.



Your ideas won’t remain in a presentation. You’ll see them developed, filmed, edited, and released for real brands.



What You’ll Do



- Turn client goals, offers, and rough ideas into original video concepts.

- Develop loglines, treatments, scripts, visual references, and creative presentations.

- Write dialogue, voiceover, action, and performance direction.

- Build stories with clear hooks, conflict, progression, and satisfying payoffs.

- Translate approved scripts into scene-by-scene storyboards.

- Plan framing, camera angles, blocking, movement, transitions, and visual reveals.

- Create shot lists that give the production team the coverage needed for the final edit.

- Recommend locations, props, wardrobe, talent, production design, and practical effects.

- Identify what needs to be captured on set versus created during post-production.

- Break concepts down into realistic production requirements.

- Adapt ideas to fit the available budget, crew, equipment, locations, and filming schedule.

- Organize multiple scripts into an efficient shoot-day plan.

- Present creative concepts and explain the reasoning behind visual choices.

- Incorporate feedback from clients, directors, producers, and editors.

- Revise scripts and boards through approval and production readiness.

- Maintain consistency between the original concept, production plan, and final creative.



What You’ll Create



Projects may include:



- Short-form commercials

- Branded narratives

- Dialogue-driven scenes and sketches

- Founder and spokesperson videos

- Product demonstrations

- Educational and authority-building content

- Testimonial and documentary-style pieces

- Paid advertising concepts

- Multi-video campaigns captured during a single production day



Standard Deliverables



Depending on the project, your production package may include:



- Creative concept or logline

- Treatment or creative deck

- Complete shooting script

- Dialogue and performance direction

- Mood board and visual references

- Scene-by-scene storyboard

- Camera and blocking notes

- Detailed shot list

- Props, wardrobe, talent, and location requirements

- Post-production and graphics notes

- Optional animatic for more complex concepts



What We’re Looking For



- Experience in creative producing, screenwriting, storyboarding, directing, commercial production, or branded content.

- A strong understanding of story structure, dialogue, pacing, character, and visual storytelling.

- The ability to turn an abstract idea into a clear plan that a production crew can execute.

- Working knowledge of camera coverage, shot composition, blocking, continuity, and editing.

- Strong visual taste and the ability to explain why a particular creative choice serves the story.

- The ability to generate ambitious ideas while remaining aware of production realities.

- Excellent written and verbal communication.

- Strong organization and attention to detail.

- Comfort presenting ideas and receiving direct creative feedback.

- The ability to manage multiple clients, concepts, and deadlines.

- A collaborative mindset without becoming overly attached to an initial idea.

- An understanding of short-form viewing behavior without relying on generic social-media formulas.



Preferred Experience



Experience with any of the following is helpful:



- Commercials and branded entertainment

- Short films or scripted comedy

- Direct-response video advertising

- Founder-led brand content

- Treatments and pitch decks

- Production breakdowns

- Camera planning and directing

- Editing or post-production

- Animation, motion design, or visual effects

- AI-assisted visual concepting and storyboarding



Tools



You may work in tools such as:



- Final Draft, Celtx, or WriterDuet

- Boords, Storyboard Pro, or FrameForge

- StudioBinder

- Adobe Creative Suite

- Figma

- Procreate

- Google Workspace

- Notion or comparable project-management platforms



We care more about the clarity and production value of your work than which software you use.



What Success Looks Like



- Every shoot begins with a clear creative vision.

- Scripts sound natural and translate effectively to the screen.

- Storyboards communicate the intended framing, action, and pacing.

- Shot lists give the crew and editor the coverage they need.

- Concepts are distinctive but achievable within the production scope.

- Clients understand and feel confident in the concept before filming.

- Shoot days are more efficient because creative decisions were made in advance.

- The finished video reflects the original idea and accomplishes its business objective.



How to Apply



Please submit:



- A brief introduction and résumé

- Two to five relevant scripts

- Two to five storyboard, treatment, or shot-list samples

- Finished videos alongside the pre-production materials you created, if available

- A clear explanation of your contribution to each project

- Your current availability

- Your hourly, day, or project rate

- The tools you use for scripting and storyboarding



We care more about the strength and relevance of your portfolio than formal education or a specific number of years in the industry.

title: Senior Server / DevOps Specialist - Linux, Docker, Cloud Infrastructure
description:
We're looking for an experienced, hands-on Server Administrator / DevOps Specialist for a project-based engagement: building isolated staging environments for our web applications, and helping us maintain and document a secure, well-organized cloud setup.



This is not an entry-level role, and it is not just a report. You will do the work.



We are a technology company that builds custom software and cloud-hosted web applications for live clients.



WHAT THE PROJECT INVOLVES

- Building isolated staging/development copies of live web applications and their databases, with a documented, repeatable process

- Server administration and security best-practice work on Linux cloud servers

- Clear infrastructure documentation for management and future developers

- Safely retiring resources that are no longer needed, following a strict change process



HOW WE WORK

Live clients come first, so caution matters more than speed. Nothing is deleted, restarted, upgraded or changed just because it looks old or unused.

Every change follows the same process: backup, dependency check, risk review, approval, execution, then testing.

You should be comfortable tracing hidden dependencies (configuration files, scheduled tasks, integrations, DNS, container networking) before touching anything.



MUST HAVE

- Strong, current Linux server administration (Ubuntu/Debian)

- Hands-on experience with DigitalOcean or similar cloud/VPS providers

- Docker and Nginx/Apache in production

- Firewall and network security configuration

- MySQL/MariaDB administration

- DNS and SSL certificate management

- Deploying Node.js applications

- Real experience cloning production apps into staging

- Clear written English, and the ability to explain risk to non-technical managers



BONUS

AWS, MongoDB, Cloudflare, Nuxt.js, PHP/WordPress hosting, cPanel, infrastructure-as-code, monitoring and backup tools.



WHO WE WANT

Someone who thinks before touching production, investigates methodically, documents as they go, never guesses when evidence is missing, and works independently. Using AI tools like Claude or ChatGPT is welcome, but you verify anything they suggest before acting on it.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with the words: SERVER AUDIT

This confirms you read the complete posting.



Then answer:

1. How many years of Linux/server administration experience do you have?

2. What is your hands-on experience with DigitalOcean or similar cloud/VPS providers?

3. What is your experience running Docker in production?

4. Give an example of cloning a live app and its database into staging. How did you keep it isolated?

5. Give an example of safely retiring an old server without breaking anything.

6. What is your experience managing DNS and SSL certificates?

7. What is your hourly or project rate?

8. What is your availability, and how soon can you start?



SCREENING QUESTION

You are asked to copy a live web application and its database onto a new staging server so developers can build the next version. Walk through, step by step, how you would do it so the staging copy can never affect live users, live data, outgoing messages, or the live domain. Please answer this in your application.



POSITION TYPE

Project-based / freelance to start, with potential for ongoing part-time support. Starting immediately.

title: Instagram DM Sales Closer (2+ Years) - Own Our DM Sales Channel
description:
JOB TITLE

Instagram DM Sales Closer (2+ Years) - Own Our DM Sales Channel



TYPE OF WORK

Part time to start (10 hrs/week), with room to grow



SALARY

PHP
per hour depending on what you can prove, plus PHP 1,100 for every 8-Week Athlete Rebuild you sell and PHP 3,000 for every 1-on-1 coaching client you sign, uncapped



HOURS

2 hours a day, Monday to Friday. Ideally 1 hour in the morning, then responding through the day to keep conversations moving (times are negotiable)



=====================================



READ THIS PART FIRST



This is not a message answering job and it is not a virtual assistant job. We are handing one person our entire Instagram sales channel and asking them to run it.



You will report to the founder, but you will have complete ownership of the sales system. If you need to be told what to do each day, this role will not work for you and you should not apply.



We want someone who has done this for at least two years, who has their own opinions about what works, and who has proven results. If you have less experience but can show us you are good, apply anyway. We care more about results and fit than years.





ABOUT US



We are an online strength and conditioning coaching business based in Sydney, Australia. We work with fighters internationally. MMA, BJJ, Muay Thai, boxing, kickboxing, wrestling, judo. Our job is to make them faster, stronger and fitter without burying them in extra training, because most of them are already on the mats 2 to 3 times a day.



The founder, Coach Izzo, is a fighter himself and has coached 250+ combat athletes. We run Instagram content and paid ads to free resources, and we get a steady flow of new leads every week. Right now the founder handles every one of those conversations between coaching clients, which means good leads go cold and follow ups get missed.



You will message from 
 account, in Coach Izzo's voice. That means learning how he talks to fighters, not sounding like a sales rep.





WHAT YOU ARE SELLING



- The 8-Week Athlete Rebuild: our entry program. One-off purchase, training plus nutrition guidance.

- 1-on-1 Coaching: our premium monthly coaching, starting with a 7-day trial.



That is it. Two offers, and we will teach you exactly who each one is for.





HOW THE ROLE GROWS



You start on our Instagram leads, in this order:



- Hot leads: people already marked qualified in Meta Leads Centre who need following up

- Warm leads: fighters who downloaded our free Performance Blueprint or commented for one of our other free resources

- Lukewarm leads: people who follow, like and comment on our content but have not reached out yet. This is a big untapped pool, because until now nobody has had time to work it



You learn our voice, our offers and our fighters, and we want you closing well before we scale your volume.



Once your numbers hold, the role grows. The next step is outbound to combat gyms, setting calls for our Academy coaching program with gym owners, as well as outbound to find more individual combat athletes for the Athlete Rebuild and 1-on-1 coaching. More hours, more commission, and it is the half of the role you get to help design.



Growth is based on your numbers, not on time served. We expect it to happen. If it does not, we hired the wrong person.





WHAT YOU OWN



Everything between a fighter seeing our content and a fighter paying us.



- Opening conversations using our scripted openers, personalised with their name and their sport where their profile shows it

- Qualifying properly, and letting go of the ones we cannot help quickly and politely

- Presenting the offer, handling objections, closing the sale

- Following up on a set cadence, not whenever you remember

- Reactivating past leads and conversations that went quiet

- Keeping every conversation labelled in Leads Centre with stage and outcome

- Owning the numbers, reporting them weekly, and telling us what the objections are saying about our offers and our content



The opener is scripted. Past the opener, the script is a guide, not a cage. We want you using your own skill to read the fighter in front of you and work the conversation to the sale.



You will be given a proven script, our offer details, an objection bank and real conversations that have already turned into sales. You are not starting from zero. But we expect you to improve on all of it. If our script is losing people at a certain point, we want you to tell us and rewrite it, not run it silently for six months.





WHAT YOU ARE NOT



You are not the coach. You will never give training advice, training load advice, nutrition advice or anything medical. If a fighter asks a specific or prescriptive training question, your job is to work around it and bring them back towards the sale. If you cannot, it goes to the founder.



Any message about an injury, or anything medical, gets escalated to the founder straight away. We are a coaching business working with athletes and this rule is not negotiable.





THE NUMBERS YOU WILL BE HELD TO



You see your own scoreboard and so do we. We review it every week.



Every day:

- 30 new conversations opened across hot, warm and lukewarm leads (150 a week)

- First reply to a new lead: within 15 minutes during your morning block

- New leads left untouched at end of day: zero

- Follow up compliance: 100% of open threads touched on cadence

- Conversations labelled in Leads Centre: 100%



How we ramp you:



Days 1 to 30: we hold you to the process and the volume above, not the sales.



Days 31 to 60: we hold you to the numbers our founder hits himself:

- Opener to reply rate: 30% or better

- Reply to offer presented: 30% or better

- Offer presented to sale: 15% or better

- Target: 7 Athlete Rebuilds and 2 new 1-on-1 clients per month



Day 61 onwards: we build towards our target numbers:

- Opener to reply rate: 40% or better

- Reply to qualified conversation: 40% or better

- Qualified to offer presented: 70% or better

- Offer presented to sale: 30% or better

- Target: 12 Athlete Rebuilds and 3 new 1-on-1 clients per month (PHP 3,000 bonus the month you hit both)





YOU WILL BE GREAT AT THIS IF



- You have 2+ years selling by chat and can show us the receipts, not just describe them

- You have owned a sales channel before, not just executed someone else's steps

- You are comfortable being ignored seven times out of ten and still showing up the next day

- Once a conversation gets going, you write like a real person. Short messages, real questions, no essays, no corporate tone, no obvious templates

- You already track your own numbers because you want to beat them

- You bring solutions. When something is broken you arrive with two options and a recommendation

- You can be trusted with our Instagram account and our founder's voice without supervision

- Bonus: you know combat sports, or fitness coaching, or you have sold to athletes before





YOU WILL HATE THIS ROLE IF



- You want a manager checking in on you three times a day

- You want a fixed script you never have to think about

- You are uncomfortable telling the founder he is wrong about something

- You have only ever done customer support or admin work in an inbox





TOOLS



Meta Business Suite and Meta Leads Centre. You must have used both before.

GoHighLevel (limited access) - you will use it to see Performance Blueprint leads and their Instagram handles so you can reach out to them on Instagram.

You should understand how ManyChat automations work in Instagram DMs. You will not be building them, but you need to know what is automated and what is you.





WHAT WE OFFER



- PHP 400 to 450 per hour based on what you can show us you have done

- PHP 1,100 for every 8-Week Athlete Rebuild you sell, uncapped, from day one

- PHP 3,000 for every 1-on-1 client you sign, paid once their 7-day trial ends and their first month is paid, uncapped, from day one

- A 30 day ramp where we guarantee a minimum of PHP 4,400 in commission while you learn, so you are not out of pocket during training

- A clear, numbers based path to more hours and outbound work, and we want you to get there fast

- A yearly budget for a sales course of your choosing

- Long term work with one client, direct access to the founder, and no layers in between

- Real room to grow. As this scales, the person in this seat runs the sales side and hires the next rep





HOW TO APPLY



Read this carefully. We reject anyone who misses a step, because following instructions is the first test of the job.



Start your message with the word REBUILD so we know you read the whole post.



Then send us:



1. A voice note, 60 to 90 seconds. Tell us why you would be good at this, and walk us through one sale you made entirely by chat, start to finish.



2. Two screenshots of real DM conversations you ran end to end. Cover the names. We want to see how you actually write.



3. Your numbers. Conversations per day, reply rate, close rate, and how you tracked them. If you do not have real numbers, say so honestly rather than inventing them.



4. A three message opener for this lead: a 24 year old amateur Muay Thai fighter downloaded our free Performance Blueprint after watching one of our reels. He has not replied to anything yet. Write the exact first three messages you would send him.



5. One thing you would change or test in a DM funnel like ours in your first month, and why. Two or three sentences is plenty. This is the question we care most about.



6. Your available start date.



Shortlisted applicants get a paid test project (for example, handling real objections from our fighters) and then an interview with the founder. We want someone in the seat within four weeks.

Bay Legal, PC is a full-service California law firm, and we are seeking a Talent Acquisition Specialist to identify, approach, and recruit high-level talent in the United States, including licensed attorneys and other senior professionals. This role goes beyond posting jobs and waiting for applicants. You will proactively search for qualified professionals who are not actively applying, reach out to them directly, and present our open positions in a way that earns their interest. You will also manage the full hiring process, from posting and screening through interviews and hire. You will work closely with firm leadership to understand each opening and deliver a steady pipeline of qualified, interested candidates.



Key Responsibilities



1. Source and identify US-based attorneys and senior professionals through LinkedIn and other professional channels

2. Review candidate profiles to assess which individuals are a strong fit for the firm's current openings, based on practice area, experience level, location, and licensure

3. Conduct direct, personalized outreach through LinkedIn messages, InMail, and
, and present open positions to potential candidates

4. Post and manage job listings across platforms such as Indeed, LinkedIn, and other relevant job boards

5. Review resumes and applications, and shortlist qualified applicants for each opening

7. Verify attorney bar status and standing through the relevant state bar websites

8. Coordinate interviews between shortlisted candidates and firm leadership

9. Serve as the main point of contact for applicants throughout the hiring process, from first contact through offer and hire

10. Maintain an organized candidate pipeline and tracker, with clear notes on every outreach and response

11. Build a long-term talent pool of attorneys and professionals for future openings

12. Provide regular updates on outreach activity, response rates, and pipeline status



Required Qualifications



1. Two or more years of full-cycle recruitment experience, including direct sourcing and outreach to US-based professionals

2. Experience recruiting attorneys, legal professionals, or other licensed or senior-level candidates in the US

3. Advanced proficiency with LinkedIn for sourcing, including LinkedIn Recruiter or Sales Navigator

4. Experience posting and managing job listings on Indeed, LinkedIn, and similar platforms

5. Proven ability to write compelling, professional outreach messages that get responses from senior candidates

6. Excellent spoken and written English, with the confidence to speak with attorneys and executives

7. Working understanding of US law firm roles and structure (associate, senior associate, of counsel, partner, paralegal) and attorney licensing

9. Ability to work hours that overlap with US Pacific Time

- Strawberry Farms in Victoria and Queensland, Australia. 



We are looking for a Digital Marketing Executive to join our growing marketing team. The ideal candidate will support the planning, execution, and optimization of digital marketing activities across our businesses.

- Strong copywriting skills with the ability to create engaging and conversion-focused content.

- A proactive attitude, strong attention to detail, and willingness to learn. 



- Ability to balance creative thinking with data-driven decision-making. 



Requirements:

- Experience managing social media platforms such as
, Instagram, LinkedIn, or similar channels.

- Strong analytical skills with the ability to monitor campaign performance and identify opportunities for improvement.

- Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal.

- Strong verbal English communication skills and the ability to write in fluent, natural UK English, using British spelling.

- Able to write 15–20 customer service
s per hour. Please show the proof during the application or interview stage.

title: Virtual Assistant – Video Coordination & Admin
description:
I’m looking for a reliable, organized virtual assistant to help coordinate video editors, review social media content, and handle general admin tasks.



**You don’t need video editing skills.** You do need a good eye for social media content, strong attention to detail, and the ability to keep work moving without constant reminders.



Your main responsibility will be managing the process between a video brief being ready and the finished video being approved.



### What you’ll do



**Coordinate video editors**

- Send editors clear briefs, footage, reference videos, and deadlines.

- Make sure they have everything they need before starting.

- Track assignments, follow up on progress, and flag delays early.

- Collect submissions and manage revision rounds.



**Review videos and give useful feedback**

- Check each submission against the brief and make sure nothing has been missed.

- Use your judgment to spot things that weaken the video: poor footage choices, awkward pacing, hard-to-read text, distracting transitions, or music that doesn’t fit.

- Check practical details such as spelling, captions, text placement, and formatting.

- Give clear, specific feedback that editors can act on—for example, “The text disappears too quickly at 0:06; please leave it on screen longer.”

- Check revised versions to confirm the requested changes have been made.



**Keep everything organized**

- Keep footage, briefs, submissions, and approved videos in the correct folders.

- Make sure files are named correctly and the latest versions are easy to find.

- Maintain an accurate tracker of assignments, deadlines, revisions, and approvals.

- Track editor invoices and payment status, and prepare payment details for my approval.



**Help with general VA tasks**

- Assist with research, data entry, document updates, scheduling, and other day-to-day admin as needed.

- Turn recurring tasks into simple checklists so the process stays consistent.



### You’ll be a good fit if you:

- Have experience as a VA, administrative assistant, project coordinator, or in a similar role.

- Are dependable, organized, and good at following through.

- Watch social media content regularly and can explain why a video feels engaging, confusing, polished, or poorly put together.

- Can follow a brief while also noticing things the brief hasn’t explicitly mentioned.

- Communicate clearly in written English and give constructive feedback.

- Ask questions when something is unclear and raise problems before they become urgent.

- Are comfortable using shared folders, spreadsheets, and task management tools.



Experience coordinating freelancers or reviewing social media content is a bonus. Video editing and graphic design skills are not required.

description:

- Work directly with the founder and senior specialists across various teams

- Opportunity to build the operating system behind a fast-growing DTC brand

title: Operations, Marketing & AI Assistant
description:
# Operations, Marketing & AI Assistant



**Part-Time → Potential Full-Time | Remote | Long-Term Opportunity**



We're an Australian company operating several businesses across **real estate, short-term accommodation, events, travel and lifestyle**.



We're looking for **two smart, reliable and resourceful assistants** who enjoy learning, solving problems and using modern technology to get things done.



This isn't a traditional VA role where you'll repeat the same tasks every day. We're looking for someone who can take an idea or problem, understand what we're trying to achieve, and help turn it into action.



**You don't need to know everything.**



We know the role sounds broad, and we absolutely don't expect you to be an expert in every area. If you're particularly strong in operations, marketing, technology, design, sales, customer service or another area, please tell us.



What matters most is that you're **curious, dependable, comfortable with AI and good at figuring things out.**



---



# What You'll Work On



Your work will mainly fall into three areas:



## 1. Real Estate Operations & Customer Service



This is an important part of the day-to-day role.



You may help with:



- Responding to rental and accommodation enquiries

- Following up leads and prospective tenants

- Managing short-term rental enquiries and bookings

- Communicating with guests and customers

- Managing property advertisements and listings

- Coordinating cleaners, maintenance and suppliers

- Basic bookkeeping and rent reconciliation

- Calculating utilities and preparing simple summaries

- Updating spreadsheets, calendars and databases

- Preparing basic documents and agreements

- Monitoring availability and bookings

- General business administration



**Responsiveness is important.**



During your agreed coverage hours, important customer and WhatsApp messages should normally be checked and acknowledged within approximately **30–60 minutes**.



---



## 2. Marketing & Growth



We don't just want someone who helps maintain the businesses. We want people who are excited about helping them grow.



Depending on your skills, you may:



- Create Instagram,
 and other social content

- Design graphics in Canva

- Edit Reels and short-form videos

- Write captions and marketing copy

- Generate and follow up leads

- Research competitors and customer behaviour

- Develop new campaigns and promotional ideas

- Assist with Meta Ads

- Improve websites and landing pages

- Create and optimise travel, accommodation and event listings

- Analyse what's working and suggest improvements

- Help turn new business ideas into actual products and campaigns



Experience with platforms such as **Airbnb, Booking.com, GetYourGuide, Klook, TripAdvisor, Eventbrite, Instagram,
/Meta or YouTube** is highly valued.



However, you don't need experience with all of them.



---



## 3. AI, Research & Building Things



This is an increasingly important part of how we work.



We actively use AI and want someone who is comfortable learning and experimenting with new tools.



You might be asked to:



- Research a new business idea

- Use AI to solve an unfamiliar problem

- Improve an existing workflow

- Create simple automations

- Help build or modify a basic website

- Use Codex or similar tools to create simple internal tools

- Research new software and recommend solutions

- Find faster and smarter ways of doing repetitive work



**You do not need to be a software developer.**



What we're interested in is your ability to think:



**"I haven't done this before, but I can figure out how."**



---



# Tools We Provide



We want you to work efficiently, so we'll provide the **paid subscriptions and professional tools required for your work**.



Depending on your responsibilities, this may include:



**ChatGPT / Codex · Canva · AI tools · video-editing software · productivity tools · other relevant software**



If a tool genuinely helps you work faster or produce better results, we're open to providing it.



We want our team equipped to do great work.



---



# Who We're Looking For



You'll probably be a great fit if you:



- Communicate naturally and confidently in English

- Learn quickly

- Are comfortable using AI

- Are reliable and responsive

- Have strong attention to detail

- Take ownership of your responsibilities

- Can work independently

- Enjoy solving problems

- Can turn ideas and voice notes into clear actions

- Don't need step-by-step instructions for everything

- Are comfortable working across different businesses



Experience in **real estate, Airbnb, customer service, administration, bookkeeping, digital marketing, social media, travel, tourism, events, Canva, video editing, coding or AI** is a bonus.



Again, **we're not expecting one person to be an expert in everything.**



Tell us what you're particularly good at.



---



# Working Arrangement



We're initially hiring for a **part-time position of approximately 25 hours across 4 days per week**.



We're flexible about how you organise your working hours. Some days will naturally be busier than others.



We're much more interested in **responsiveness, ownership and results** than watching someone sit in front of a computer for a fixed number of hours.



Because our businesses operate throughout the week, we're hiring two people who will cover different days.



---



# What You Can Earn



### First 2 Weeks — Paid Trial



You'll begin with a **2-week paid trial** at:



**A$100 per week** 

Approximately **25 hours across 4 days** needs to work on day on weekend



The trial gives both sides an opportunity to understand the work and see whether we're a good long-term fit.



### After the Trial



After two weeks, we'll review your performance and decide together on the next step.



You may continue in the **part-time role**:



**A$150/week base + performance bonuses (average out to be around $200 per month)** 

Approximately ** 30 hours across 4 days**



Or, for the right person and depending on our needs, there may be an opportunity to move into a **full-time role**:



**A$250/week base + performance bonuses (average out to be around $200 per month)*** 

Approximately **45 hours across 6 days**



We value people based on the **value they bring to the business**, and there is room to grow as your skills, responsibilities and contribution increase.



---



# How to Apply



We'd like to move the hiring process **quickly**, so please apply only if you're genuinely interested and available to begin soon.



### Step 1 — Apply



Send us your **CV/resume**, a short introduction, your current availability, and tell us:



**What are you particularly good at?**



Don't worry about writing a long generic cover letter.



### Step 2 — Practical Assessment



Selected applicants will receive a **short hands-on task**.



This will help us understand how you think, communicate, prioritise and solve problems.



**You are welcome to use AI.**



### Step 3 — Interview



Applicants who perform well in the assessment will be invited to a short online interview.



### Step 4 — Paid Trial



Successful applicants will begin the **2-week paid trial**, after which we'll decide whether to continue with the part-time role or potentially expand the position.



We're looking for someone who wants to **learn, contribute and grow with us long term.**



To show you've read the full advertisement, please begin your application with:



**Blue Koala 🐨**

Stable internet connection

Nice-to-Haves

AI image generation experience (Higgsfield or similar tools)

AI creative is the fastest-moving skill in marketing right now, and most designers are learning it on personal projects with no feedback loop. You'll learn it on real ad spend.

Direct access to ad performance data on your own creatives, so you learn what converts, not just what looks good

Our internal prompt library and workflows, plus the paid AI tools to run them

Not a Fit If

You need a fixed schedule or close supervision to stay productive

You want to make art rather than ads that perform

Working Style

Engagement: Independent contractor, paid in USD

Location: 100% remote

It takes about 5 minutes. We review every application.

title: Performance Video Editor (High Salary)
description:
Performance Video Editor

Exchange Life · Fully Remote · Full-Time Contractor · ~40 hrs/week $10–30 USD/hour depending on experience + uncapped performance bonuses



About Exchange Life

Exchange Life is one of the fastest-growing e-commerce travel jewellery brands in the US. We sell collectible country charms for traveller's, with new products launching soon. Our content machine has generated over a quarter billion views across TikTok and Instagram.



This role is video, end to end. You'll concept and cut short-form video ads for paid media across TikTok, Reels, and Meta placements, where every edit is judged on what it does to hook rate, retention, and spend. You're not making brand films or organic filler. You're making the creative we put budget behind.



We're looking for an editor who can own their output and be creative within proven marketing fundamentals, not just execute tasks. This is not a gig; it's a long-term partnership. Many of our editors have been with us 2+ years, and the people who now set our creative direction started as editors here.



You'll work closely with our Content Lead and Marketing team. We're a small, high-output team that moves fast, communicates daily, and invests in the people who show up.



Where You'll Be in Six Months

Senior Performance Video Editor.



That's the next title, and it's within reach inside your first six months if your work earns it. At that level you have full creative autonomy: you own video concepts end to end, you d
 which angles we test next instead of receiving briefs, your creatives are the ones we put real spend behind, and you start reviewing other editors' cuts and shaping how they work.



It's d
 by performance, not time served. Move faster if your work moves faster.



Compensation & Earning Potential

Base: $10–20 USD/hour depending on experience

Performance bonuses: Uncapped, paid per winning creative. Every video that hits our performance thresholds or scales on paid ads pays out.

Rate reviews: Revisited as you take on more, not on an annual calendar

Our top editors earn meaningfully more than their base because they produce winners consistently. That's the whole design: we'd rather pay a lot for creatives that work than a little for creatives that don't.



What Success Looks Like

After 3–6 months, a successful hire is consistently producing short-form video ads that scale on paid and perform organically, hitting 50%+ thumb-stop rates and 30%+ hold rates, and iterating on winning formats without needing direction from the marketing team. You'll be a trusted creative partner, not just an executor.



Core Responsibilities

Concept and edit short-form video ads for TikTok, Reels, and Meta, built around hook rate, retention, and watch time rather than aesthetics

Develop new video angles and hooks, then test them against our proven formats

Build AI-assisted video creative using current tools, and keep pace as those tools change

Review your past edits daily, identify what's working and what isn't, and improve without repeating mistakes

Work directly from paid performance data to d
 what to cut next

Turn around content quickly and communicate proactively every day, with no check-ins required

Stay on top of TikTok and Instagram trends and apply them where they'll actually convert

Must-Haves

A strong recent portfolio of short-form video edits, ideally including paid ad creative (20+ from the last few months)

You can watch a winning video ad and break down exactly what made it work

Hands-on experience across video formats: hook-led headline videos, talking heads, voiceovers, UGC-style edits, AI video

Ability to read metrics (hook rate, retention, watch time, spend) and know what to change in the next cut

Takes ownership, internalizes feedback, doesn't repeat the same mistake twice

Highly skilled in CapCut Pro or a comparable editing tool

Strong written and spoken English; able to work independently

Nice-to-Haves

Experience cutting video ads for e-commerce or DTC brands

Experience working directly against Meta or TikTok ad account data

A track record of creatives that scaled on paid

What You'll Learn Here

Most editing jobs teach you software. This one teaches you why video sells.



Direct access to paid performance data on real ad spend, so you see exactly which of your creatives print and which die

1-on-1 mentorship from our Content Lead

Paid courses and software, including the AI video tools you'll be working in

A portfolio backed by numbers, not vibes. "This cut did 4M views and scaled to $X/day" is a career asset that follows you.

Not a Fit If

Your portfolio is mostly long-form, YouTube, or event/wedding content

You can't point to a recent video ad and explain why it performed

You want to make beautiful videos more than videos that sell

You need a fixed schedule or close supervision to stay productive

You're looking for a short-term project or side gig

Working Style

Engagement: Independent contractor, paid in USD

Location: 100% remote

Hours: ~40 hrs/week, long-term role

Schedule: Fully flexible. Work whenever you want, as long as you turn work around quickly and communicate daily (async). No timezone overlap required.

Time off: Flexible PTO. Take the time you need, just coordinate with the team.

Tools: CapCut Pro (or comparable), AI video tools, TikTok/Meta analytics

Working style: No micromanagement

How to Apply

It takes about 5 minutes. We review every application.

title: Architectural Rendering & Photoshop Designer – LED Lighting
description:
About the Company



We are a growing architectural LED lighting company based in Montreal, Canada. We design and install high-end permanent exterior LED lighting systems on residential and commercial properties.



We are looking for a talented Architectural Rendering / Photoshop Designer to join our team and help us create realistic lighting visualizations for our customers.



What you will be doing



You will receive photos of real properties from our sales team, along with an internal markup showing exactly where our lighting system should be installed.



Your job will be to transform the original property photo into a realistic visualization showing what the property will look like with our permanent LED lighting installed.



The finished render should look as realistic as possible — typically during dusk or nighttime — with realistic lighting, shadows, glow and reflections on the property.



We primarily show customers warm white lighting, but we also want the ability to create different colors and lighting effects when requested.



Typical workflow:



Receive a raw property photo from our salesperson

Receive our internal markup showing exactly where the lighting should be installed

Add our LED lighting system realistically to the property

Create realistic dusk/nighttime lighting

Add realistic glow, shadows, reflections and light spill where appropriate

Create different color options and lighting effects

Produce high-quality images that can be presented directly to the customer

Make revisions based on feedback from our sales team



We currently use Photoshop and AI-based tools in our workflow, including Magnific AI, and we are very open to using AI to improve both the quality and speed of our work.



AI experience is a plus. We want someone who is creative and resourceful and who is constantly looking for better and faster ways to achieve realistic results.



3D experience is NOT required, because many of our projects can be completed through high-quality 2D photo manipulation and compositing.



However, experience with Blender, SketchUp, 3ds Max, Lumion, Enscape, or other 3D/architectural visualization software is a major plus. We are interested in someone who could potentially create 3D models/renderings when a project requires it.



Experience creating animated lighting effects or short visualizations is also a plus.



What we are looking for



Strong Photoshop skills

Experience with realistic photo manipulation and compositing

Strong understanding of lighting, shadows, perspective and realism

Experience with architectural/exterior/property images is highly preferred

Ability to make added elements look like they were actually present in the original photograph

Good eye for detail

Ability to follow precise instructions and work from marked-up images

Comfortable using AI tools in the design workflow

Creative and willing to experiment with new tools and techniques

3D/Blender experience is a strong advantage but not mandatory

Ability to work independently and meet deadlines



Hours



We are initially looking for approximately 20–30 hours per week, with the possibility of increasing hours as our demand for customer mockups increases.



This position will primarily focus on architectural lighting renders. There may also be opportunities to work on website graphics, marketing visuals and other design projects, but the main responsibility will be creating property lighting visualizations.



IMPORTANT – Portfolio Required



Please include a portfolio showing examples of your work, especially:



Architectural/exterior renders

Realistic Photoshop compositing

Property/house visualization

Lighting visualization

Before/after photo manipulation

3D architectural visualization if applicable



We care much more about the quality of your work than the number of years of experience you have.

title: Remote Cold Caller / Appointment Setter
description:

* Follow call scripts while sounding natural and conversational

* Complete follow-up calls according to an established schedule

* Respect all do-not-call requests and company outreach policies

* Previous cold-calling, appointment-setting, telemarketing or outbound sales experience

* Clear, professional spoken English that is easily understood by North American prospects

* Comfortable calling businesses and speaking with receptionists and decision-makers

* Friendly, confident and persistent without being aggressive

Experience calling medical clinics, professional offices or other service businesses is helpful, but not required. We value strong communication skills and reliability more than experience in one specific industry.

“We’re not interested. You can send something to our general email.”

title: E-commerce Designer Who Lets Data Decide - Shopify Brand & CRO (Part-Time to Full-Time)
description:
We are a fast-growing Danish e-commerce brand selling children's products on Shopify. We're looking for a designer who genuinely cares about brand consistency, typography, colors and clean design - and who is also comfortable letting test data have the final word.



Here's what that means in practice: you'll design beautiful, brand-aligned pages and elements for our store, and then we test them. Sometimes your favorite version will win. Sometimes a version you find less elegant will convert better, and that version goes live - and you get to design a new, better-looking challenger for the next round. If that sounds like a fun game rather than a frustration, you'll love it here.



Who we are:

We are a small, fully remote team of five, working closely together every day in Slack. We have a weekly tea
eting where everyone joins, and despite the distance it genuinely feels like a team - people help each other, celebrate wins together, and nobody is left alone with a problem. Several of our tea
mbers are based in the Philippines and have been with us for a long time.



We have high expectations and we're honest about that - but we match them with real flexibility (you largely plan your own hours), stable long-term work, and a leader who invests time in helping you grow. If you do good work here, you will be seen, appreciated, and given more responsibility.



What you'll do:





Design and improve store pages, sections and campaign elements - always on-brand, always clean

Turn your designs into real A/B tests and let the data d
 what stays

Keep the entire store visually consistent as we add products and campaigns

Own the theme technically: changes in theme copies, deploy checklist, tracking verified after every change

Produce SEO blog content and visuals using AI workflows (Claude/ChatGPT) - secondary priority

Be our go-to when something on the site looks or behaves wrong





Requirements:





Strong visual/design skills with real webshop examples you can show

Solid Shopify experience (themes, sections, basic Liquid)

You have experienced data overruling one of your own designs - and you can tell us about it

Excellent written English, self-managing, reliable internet and backup power





Structure: 20 hours/week to start. Transition to full-time within 3-6 months based on results - we define what success looks like together in month 1, so you always know where you stand. We are scaling into new European markets from 2027, and this role grows with us.



In your video introduction (see below), please also tell us about ONE time where test data went against a design you personally loved: what the data said, and what you did next. This is the most important part of your application.



HOW TO APPLY

We do NOT read applications sent through the OnlineJobs message system. If you apply through OnlineJobs directly, your application will not be seen. The only way to be considered is to send your application to the email above.

, complete one round of the English typing test, and attach a screenshot showing your WPM and accuracy.

title: Creative Strategist - DTC Ecommerce / Meta Ads
description:
Job Overview

We are a fast-growing US-focused DTC ecommerce brand looking for an experienced Creative Strategist to take ownership of our paid social creative testing pipeline. 



In this role, you will lead the creative engine end-to-end: conducting deep customer research, developing angles grounded in consumer psychology, producing production-ready briefs for editors and creators, analyzing post-launch ad performance, and systematically iterating on winning creative.



If you know how to turn customer pain points and data into high-converting Meta ads that scale—and you have a repeatable system for doing it—we want to work with you.



---



Key Responsibilities

- Customer & Market Research: Dive deep into customer reviews, competitor ads, TikTok/Reels trends, Reddit, and forums to uncover fresh psychological angles, unaddressed pain points, and hook opportunities.

- Concept & Angle Development: Formulate clear creative hypotheses and concepts across multiple direct-response formats (UGC, founder/brand story, problem-solution, unboxing, press/PR, native TikTok style, and high-impact statics).

- High-Volume Briefing: Build detailed, production-ready creative briefs for video editors and UGC creators—complete with visual directions, hook variations, copy/voiceover scripts, text overlays, and pacing notes.

- Performance Analysis & Iteration: Review Meta Ads Manager and attribution data weekly alongside the media buying team. Break down *why* an ad won or lost (thumbstop rate, hold rate, CTR, CPA, ROAS) and rapidly produce iteration batches (new hooks, different lead-ins, CTA shifts).

- Creative Systems & Velocity: Help refine and document our creative strategy SOPs, swipe files, and testing frameworks to maintain a predictable, high-velocity creative testing pipeline.

- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner directly with the founders, media buyers, editors, and creators to ensure creative runs smoothly from ideation to launch.



---



Qualifications & Requirements

- Proven track record on Meta Ads 
 & Instagram): You understand direct-response fundamentals, thumbstop rates (3-second hook rate), hold rates, CTR, and how creative dictates cost per acquisition.

- Direct-Response & Consumer Psychology: Deep understanding of customer awareness stages (problem-aware, solution-aware, product-aware) and how to write hooks that stop the scroll.

- High-Quality Briefing Skills: Ability to write clear, foolproof briefs that editors and creators can execute without endless back-and-forth.

- Industry Experience: Direct experience in DTC physical products (wellness, home goods, sleep, health, beauty, or hardware) is a huge plus.

- Reliable Setup: High-speed internet, dependable workstation, and strong written English communication skills.

- Ability to work US hours.



---



Role Details

- Position: Full-Time Independent Contractor (40 hours/week)

- Location: 100% Remote (Philippines-based)

- Hours: Overlap required with US working hours for syncs and team communication.

- Growth: Stable, long-term position with room to grow alongside the brand.



---



How to Apply

Please provide:



1. Scalable Win (Brief & Angle): Share a link to (or attachment of) one actual creative brief you personally wrote for an ad that successfully scaled. Explain the core psychological angle behind it and why you believe it worked.

2. End-to-End Case Study: Walk us through one specific creative you took from initial customer research and briefing through to live launch data, what you learned from the metrics, and how you iterated on it.

3. Capacity & Output: In a typical 40-hour week, how many production-ready briefs can you comfortably deliver, and how many hook/asset variations does each brief typically yield?

4. Links: Provide a link to your portfolio, swipe file, or examples of previous creative work/briefs (Google Drive, Notion, Loom, or PDF).

title: $500/Month — Wedding Video Editor | Paid Training, Constant Work, Weekly Pay | Long-Term
description:
We are a wedding-video business looking for reliable Adobe Premiere Pro editors who want a long-term position and a steady flow of paid work.



THE JOB OFFER



• Ongoing wedding-video editing in small, clearly defined assignments

• Weekly payment through PayPal for approved work

• An average of US$500 per month

• A clear path from a short skills assessment to paid training and then regular paid work with our team



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU



• Working knowledge of Adobe Premiere Pro

• A Windows PC suitable for running Adobe Premiere Pro; this workflow is PC-based

• Ability to receive payments through PayPal

• Careful attention to instructions and detail

• Fast, dependable delivery and responsive communication

• Conversational English

• Availability Monday–Friday, 09:00–14:00 GMT+3, during training. After training, you can work whenever you like, as long as you meet all deadlines.

• Willingness to ask questions and report progress



Previous wedding or multicamera editing experience is welcome, but it is not required. Some of our best editors joined us without any wedding-editing experience.



STEP 1: SHORT SKILLS ASSESSMENT



Shortlisted candidates complete a brief paid editing assessment before training, for which you will be paid. The assessment uses real wedding footage from a project that was completed and delivered several years ago. You will not send us the Adobe Premiere Pro project file. You will submit only timeline screenshots and low-quality video renders so we can review the timing of your cuts, the beats, and which shots you selected—nothing more. The assessment consists of an already synced five-minute multicam timeline and a 30-second reception timeline and should take approximately 10 minutes of editing time if you have some experience editing in Adobe Premiere Pro. It is used to confirm that you can understand the workflow, follow instructions accurately, communicate well, and deliver on time.



STEP 2: PAID TRAINING



Candidates who pass the test enter paid training. You receive access to our learning platform, training videos, tutorials, and guidance from a personal tutor during the training hours above. Training continues until you reach the editing standard required for ongoing work. The training rate and milestones will be confirmed before training begins.



ONGOING PAID WORK AND CONTINUED TRAINING



Once you complete the initial training, you will begin receiving a constant flow of paid wedding-video assignments with synced material and clear instructions. Our syncers handle synchronization, our ML system supplies the preprocessed multicam, you vet the result, and our QC team reviews the complete multicam.



The learning does not stop when the paid work begins. Your real assignments will go hand in hand with continued training as you learn every part of our wedding-video workflow. You will progress step by step through the different types of edits until you reach the highest level: creating complete wedding highlights.



We are looking for editors who want to stay, improve, take on more responsibility, and become long-term members of our team.



HOW TO APPLY



1. Start your application with the word CEREMONY so we know you read the full post.

2. Include a 30-second audio introduction. This is required so we can assess your spoken English.

3. Confirm that you work on a Windows PC.

4. Confirm that you can receive payments through PayPal.

5. Confirm that you can be available Monday–Friday, 09:00–14:00 GMT+3, during paid training.

6. If you have edited wedding videos before, you are welcome to include one link to your best wedding highlight. This is optional; previous wedding-editing experience is not required.

title: Paid Media & E-Commerce Growth Specialist
description:
Meta Ads | Google Ads | E-Commerce | Subscription Growth



Full-Time Remote | Long-Term Opportunity | Australian E-Commerce & Subscription Business



Paddock 2 Porch is an established Australian fresh fruit and vegetable home-delivery business servicing customers from the Gold Coast through Tweed and into the Northern Rivers.



We are looking for an experienced Paid Media & E-Commerce Growth Specialist to help take the business through its next stage of growth.



This is not a social media manager, content posting or general VA role.



The core of this position is performance marketing — particularly Meta Ads and Google Ads.



We want someone who has genuine hands-on experience acquiring customers profitably for e-commerce businesses and understands the numbers behind paid acquisition.



Our business already has an established customer base and significant recurring subscription revenue. Our next priority is building a much stronger customer acquisition engine — particularly for weekly and fortnightly subscribers.



THE PRIMARY OBJECTIVE



Your job is straightforward:



Help us acquire more profitable customers and subscribers through Meta and Google.



We are not looking for someone who simply launches campaigns, adjusts budgets and sends us a monthly ROAS report.



We want someone who can understand:



Creative → Click → Landing Page → Checkout → First Purchase → Subscription → Retention → LTV



And use that understanding to determine:



Which campaigns are genuinely working

Which customers we should be targeting

What we can afford to pay to acquire them

Which creative and offers are producing results

Where customers are dropping out of the funnel

Whether platform-reported conversions are actually translating into business growth

What we should test next

How we can scale successful campaigns profitably

META ADS



You should be highly experienced with Meta Ads for e-commerce.



You will take significant responsibility for:



Meta Ads Manager

Campaign strategy and structure

Prospecting and customer acquisition

Retargeting

Audience strategy

Budget allocation

Creative testing

Offer testing

Campaign optimisation

Scaling successful campaigns

Meta Pixel and Conversion API

Conversion events

Attribution

Analysing creative performance

Understanding when Meta's reported ROAS does — and does not — reflect genuine business growth



We particularly value someone who understands that modern Meta advertising is not simply about finding another audience.



Creative, offer, customer economics and measurement all matter.



You should be able to look at an underperforming account, understand why it is underperforming and develop a structured testing plan to improve it.



GOOGLE ADS



Strong Google Ads experience is also highly desirable.



Depending on your expertise, this may include:



Google Search

Shopping

Performance Max

Google Merchant Center

Product feeds

Brand vs non-brand performance

Search intent

Campaign structure

Budget allocation

Conversion tracking

Remarketing

Customer acquisition

Measuring incremental performance



We want someone capable of determining where Google fits alongside Meta rather than treating each platform in isolation.



ATTRIBUTION & ANALYTICS



This is extremely important to us.



We use several sources of business data, including WooCommerce, GA4, Meta, Google, Klaviyo and Metorik.



We do not assume that because Meta or Google claims a conversion, the advertising platform necessarily created that sale.



We want someone who understands attribution and can help us determine what is actually happening.



You should be comfortable working with:



Revenue | New Customers | New Subscribers | CAC | Subscription CAC | Conversion Rate | AOV | LTV | Contribution Margin | ROAS | MER | CTR | CPC | Retention | Churn | Returning Customers | Funnel Performance



You should understand the differences between:



Platform-reported ROAS

GA4 attribution

Last-click attribution

Blended CAC

MER

New-customer acquisition

Incremental growth

Returning-customer revenue

Subscription LTV



You don't need to be a data scientist.



But you do need to be highly analytical and comfortable questioning the numbers.



If Meta says it generated $20,000 of revenue but total business revenue only increased by $5,000, we expect you to investigate why rather than simply reporting the $20,000.



SUBSCRIPTION GROWTH



One of our biggest opportunities is subscriptions.



Paddock 2 Porch offers weekly and fortnightly fruit and vegetable box subscriptions alongside once-off purchases.



A subscriber can be significantly more valuable than a once-off customer, which means our acquisition strategy needs to consider the lifetime value of the customer — not simply the first transaction.



We want to understand:



Subscription CAC

First-order conversion

Once-off customer CAC

Subscriber LTV

Retention

Churn

Payback period

Which campaigns and creatives generate the best long-term customers

How much more we can afford to pay to acquire a subscriber



The objective isn't simply to generate cheap purchases.



It is to acquire valuable long-term customers profitably.



CREATIVE STRATEGY



You do not need to be our graphic designer or video editor.



However, you should understand performance creative.



You should be capable of analysing creative results and helping determine:



What hooks are working

Which angles resonate with customers

Which offers perform

What formats should be tested

Why particular ads are succeeding or failing

What new creative we should produce next



You should be able to develop clear creative briefs based on performance data.



We can then produce the required assets internally or through dedicated creative resources.



E-COMMERCE & CRO



Our website runs on WooCommerce/WordPress.



Strong WooCommerce experience is valuable, but you do not need to be a WooCommerce developer.



You should understand the e-commerce customer journey well enough to recognise when the problem isn't actually the advertising.



For example:



If Meta is generating qualified traffic but customers aren't purchasing, we want someone who investigates the landing page, offer, mobile experience, checkout and conversion rate before simply changing the ads.



Experience with the following is therefore highly valuable:



WooCommerce

WordPress

Landing pages

Checkout optimisation

Mobile conversion

CRO

Subscription e-commerce

Klaviyo

/SMS retention

GA4

Google Tag Manager



You do not need to personally solve every technical problem.



What matters is being able to identify what is affecting performance, explain why it matters and work with the appropriate person to fix it.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



The ideal person has genuine hands-on experience managing and growing e-commerce businesses through paid advertising.



You should:



Be genuinely advanced in Meta Ads

Have strong Google Ads experience

Have managed meaningful e-commerce advertising budgets

Understand customer acquisition economics

Understand CAC and LTV

Understand attribution

Understand GA4 and conversion measurement

Understand Meta Pixel and Conversion API

Be highly analytical

Understand creative testing

Understand e-commerce conversion funnels

Be comfortable making decisions from data

Understand subscription or recurring-revenue economics

Be commercially minded

Take ownership of results

Be curious about why performance changes

Continually develop and test new hypotheses

Communicate clearly

Be interested in building something over the long term



Experience with WooCommerce and subscription businesses is highly desirable.



WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT



This is not primarily:



Social media management

Posting to Instagram

Writing captions

Community management

Influencer management

Graphic design

Website development

General virtual assistant work

Pure technical implementation



Technical knowledge is valuable, particularly around tracking and attribution, but we are hiring a performance marketer first.



THE OPPORTUNITY



We are initially looking at approximately a 6-month full-time engagement, with the intention of creating a permanent long-term role for the right person.



You will work directly with the owner and have visibility into the real commercial performance of the business.



You won't simply be given an advertising budget and told to generate clicks.



You'll have access to customer, subscription, revenue and retention data so that advertising decisions can be based on the actual economics of the business.



Our goal is to develop a repeatable acquisition system that allows us to confidently invest more into advertising because we understand:



What we spend → who we acquire → what they are worth → how long they stay → what profit they generate.



If you can help us build that system, there is significant opportunity for the role to grow as the business grows.



We care much more about demonstrated performance, analytical ability, commercial thinking and results than qualifications.



HOW TO APPLY



Please do not send us a generic application.



Start your application by briefly telling us about yourself and your experience, then answer the following questions.



1. Meta Ads experience



Tell us about an e-commerce Meta Ads account you personally managed.



What was the approximate monthly ad spend when you started, what did you change, and what happened to CAC, ROAS and/or revenue?



Please be specific about what you personally did.



2. Underperforming Meta account



You inherit an established e-commerce Meta account currently producing approximately a 1.0 ROAS.



What information would you examine before changing anything?



What would determine your first three actions?



3. Attribution



Meta reports $20,000 of revenue from its campaigns, but total business revenue has only increased by $5,000.



How would you investigate whether Meta is actually generating incremental sales?



4. Google Ads



Describe an e-commerce Google Ads account you have personally managed.



Which campaign types did you use, what was the approximate spend, and what measurable improvement did you achieve?



5. Meta vs Google



How do you think about the different roles of Meta Ads and Google Ads in an e-commerce customer acquisition strategy?



6. Subscription economics



An e-commerce business sells both once-off purchases and weekly/fortnightly subscriptions.



A once-off customer is worth $90 on their first purchase.



A subscriber is also worth $90 on their first purchase but generates substantially more revenue over the following 12 months.



How would you determine how much we can afford to pay to acquire each customer?



7. Performance diagnosis



Paid traffic increases 40%, but new-customer sales increase only 10%.



What would you investigate?



8. Creative testing



Explain how you would structure a Meta creative-testing program for an established e-commerce business.



What would you test, how would you judge results and how would those results determine what creative we produce next?



9. Measurement



What are the five numbers you would most want to see every Monday morning to understand whether our paid acquisition is producing profitable business growth?



Explain why you chose each one.



10. Platform expertise



Rate yourself from 1–10 based on genuine professional experience in each of the following:



Meta Ads / Meta Business Manager / Google Ads / Google Merchant Center / GA4 / GTM / Meta Pixel / Conversion API / WooCommerce / CRO / Klaviyo / E-Commerce Analytics



Please don't rate platforms you haven't personally used.



11. Previous results



Please provide examples of e-commerce businesses you have worked with.



For each one, include where possible:



Your personal role

Monthly ad spend

Meta and/or Google

Approximate CAC

ROAS

Revenue growth

Other measurable improvements you personally contributed to



12. First 30 days



If you joined Paddock 2 Porch tomorrow and had access to our Meta Ads, Google Ads, GA4, WooCommerce and customer/subscription data, what would your first 30 days look like?



13. Salary and location



What is your expected monthly salary for a full-time position?



What country and city are you based in?



We are looking for someone who can become a key part of our growth team — someone who understands paid acquisition deeply, understands the numbers behind it, continually tests new ideas and ultimately helps us build a profitable and scalable customer acquisition engine.

title: Media Buyer / Creative Strategist (Meta Ads + AI Creative) for US Ecommerce Agency
description:
US ecommerce agency hiring a full-time remote Media Buyer / Creative Strategist in the Philippines. $1,300–2,000 USD/month paid via Wise, mostly async with one weekly call in US Pacific hours, Meta-first. Apply through the form linked below. A Loom video and three creative examples are required, so only apply if you're up for that.



Also known as: Paid Media Specialist, Paid Media Strategist, Performance Marketer,
 Ads Specialist. If you've held any of those titles and you also make the creative, not just run it, this is you.



ABOUT US



BLOOM10X is a boutique paid-media agency based in the US. We are an English-speaking company and our clients are American ecommerce brands, so every client call, update and report is in English. We run Meta and Google Ads, creative production, tracking, lifecycle
 and reporting for ecommerce brands, both DTC and B2B. We work with a small number of clients at a time and keep them for years. We use AI workflows for creative, analysis and reporting. You'd work directly with the founder.



THE ROLE



You own the day-to-day execution of paid media across our client accounts. The founder sets strategy. You execute it, keep the accounts healthy, produce the creative through our AI workflows, and own reporting. This is an execution role for someone who loves the details and hates seeing a campaign run with a broken pixel or a stale creative. Meta comes first in this role; Google is a plus. You buy the media and you make the creative that feeds it.



You get the whole system on day one: our campaign templates, naming conventions, creative workflows, recorded training Looms and reporting dashboards. AI does the heavy lifting on drafts, variations and data pulls. The judgment calls, the QA and the creative direction are yours.



HOW WE WORK ACROSS TIME ZONES



You work your own daytime hours in the Philippines. We run async: written end-of-day updates in Slack, ClickUp tasks, Loom videos instead of meetings. The only fixed commitment is one 30-minute call per week during US Pacific business hours (late evening in Manila), plus being reachable on Slack within a few hours during your working day. Urgent account issues that come up in the US afternoon wait for your morning, and that's fine; we plan for it.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



• Build and launch Meta and Google campaigns following our strategy briefs and naming conventions

• Monitor accounts daily: budget pacing, disapprovals, tracking breaks, creative fatigue

• Adjust bids, budgets, audiences and placements based on performance

• Produce ad creative (statics, hooks, scripts, UGC briefs) using our AI workflows and templates

• Pull weekly performance reports, populate the client dashboard and flag wins and problems before anyone asks

• QA every campaign before it goes live

• Send a written end-of-day update every working day

• Join client calls occasionally (in English, scheduled in advance)



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE AT 90 DAYS



• Every campaign you launch has passed our pre-launch QA checklist. Zero preventable errors reach a client account.

• Weekly client reports go out on schedule with wins, problems and next steps, before the client asks.

• A steady weekly pipeline of new creatives is moving through our workflows, tagged and tracked so we know what's winning.

• Tracking breaks, disapprovals and budget-pacing issues are caught and flagged the same day you see them.

• You can walk the founder through any account's structure and explain why it looks the way it does.



REQUIREMENTS (all of these, no exceptions)



• 2+ years running Meta Ads for ecommerce brands. Not lead gen, not local services, not B2B SaaS. Google Ads is a plus, not a substitute.

• You have produced ad creative yourself, not just briefed it: written hooks and scripts, built statics, edited short video, or generated with AI. We'll ask for three examples.

• Managed at least $10K/month on a single account, or $50K+/month across accounts

• Can prove it: screenshots or case studies showing budget, ROAS and what you did

• Comfortable with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Canva or similar). We'll test this.

• Strong English, written and spoken. You'll write client updates and join client calls.

• Based in the Philippines, available for one weekly call in US Pacific hours, and responsive on Slack during your working day

• Reliable internet and a quiet workspace, with a backup connection and backup power

• Bonus: Klaviyo, Shopify, TikTok Ads, GA4



WHO YOU ARE



• Proactive. If you see a problem, you fix it or flag it. You don't wait to be told.

• Detail-oriented. You catch mistakes before they go live.

• Low ego. You're here to execute the strategy well, not to redesign it on week one.

• Direct. If something in the plan doesn't make sense, you say so. We'd rather hear "this won't work" than a quiet yes.

• Reliable. You show up, you hit deadlines, you don't disappear.



WHAT WE OFFER



• $1,300–2,000 USD/month base depending on experience, paid in USD via Wise twice a month (15th and last day), plus a quarterly performance bonus tied to client retention and account results, and a year-end bonus

• Full-time, 40 hours/week, fully remote, your own daytime hours

• 12 days paid vacation per year (available after 90 days), 5 paid sick days, and the 12 Philippine regular holidays off (special non-working days are normal workdays)

• $50/month internet stipend

• All tools provided (Meta, Google, Slack, ClickUp, Google Workspace, AI tools)

• Quarterly performance reviews with a clear path to raises; the first review is at 90 days

• Growth: as we scale, this role becomes Senior Media Buyer managing a small team

• Direct access to the founder. You'll learn how a high-margin AI-enhanced agency actually runs.



HOW TO APPLY



Do not apply through OnlineJobs.ph messages. Apply through our form: 



Answer every question in English. The form is one page and takes about 20 minutes. Have these ready:



1. Your CV or LinkedIn profile

2. 2–3 case studies or screenshots of campaigns you've managed, with ad spend, ROAS and what you did

3. Short answers (2–3 sentences each) to three questions about a campaign you've run, the AI tools you use, and why a small agency

4. A Loom video (2–3 minutes, in English) walking through one of your best-performing ad accounts

5. Three ads you made or wrote yourself, with one line on what you did and how each performed



Applications without the Loom video or the creative examples will not be reviewed. We review on a rolling basis and reply to strong candidates within 3–5 days. Shortlisted candidates do a 30-minute interview, then a short paid test project.
